create_Categorical2DSemanticMapState: create a Categorical2DSemanticMapState instance with device, num_environments, num_sem_categories, map_resolution, map_size_cm, and global_downscaling parameters
init_map_and_pose: initialize global and local map and sensor pose variables for all environments in the semantic map state
get_semantic_map: get the local semantic category map for a specific environment as a numpy array
get_obstacle_map: get the local obstacle map for a specific environment as a numpy array
local_to_global: convert local map row and column coordinates to global map coordinates for a given environment
